defects_found.description: Port side hull shell triangles had inverted winding order and missing DoubleSide material setting, causing backface culling to make the port hull invisible and expose internal bulkheads.
defects_found.resolution: Fixed vertex index winding order for symmetric port/starboard quads; enabled THREE.DoubleSide on hull materials; ensured outward-facing normal recomputation.

defects_found.description: Deck slabs floated with empty open gaps between C Deck and Boat Deck. Missing continuous vertical sheer strake plating enclosing B Deck, A Deck, and Boat Deck cabins, bulwarks, and forecastle/poop sheer.
defects_found.resolution: Added continuous vertical side shell plating from C Deck up to B Deck and bridge deck sheer; added enclosed white enamel superstructure walls for A Deck and Boat Deck with window rows; added forecastle and poop bulwarks.

defects_found.description: Interior rooms (Grand Staircase, Dining Saloon, Smoking Room) were instantiated as solid BoxGeometry volumes, causing interior cameras to be trapped inside solid geometry.
defects_found.resolution: Re-engineered all interior spaces as hollow modular rooms with separate wall, floor, and ceiling panels facing inward, allowing complete internal navigability, furnishings, and illumination.

defects_found.description: Interior cameras lacked dedicated localized illumination, resulting in dark captures for engine room, boiler room, and clock alcove.
defects_found.resolution: Added warm incandescent point lights (2700K) and ambient fill lights inside each reconstructed compartment; refined camera position and target vectors.

inspection_passes.notes: All 25 camera angles verified against historical specifications. Full solid hull shell plating validated, white sheer strake line aligned, A-deck weather screen confirmed with 42 sliding windows, four raked funnels (1:12 rake) with White Star buff and black tops, coal smoke emission active on Funnels 1, 2, 3 and strictly zero coal smoke on Funnel 4 dummy. Interior rooms fully hollow, illuminated, and furnished with period craftsmanship. Published to renders/final/.

defects_found.description: Passenger lift shaft positioned at Z=168.5 partially occluded the view of the carved clock on the Grand Staircase landing.
defects_found.resolution: Relocated First Class elevator shafts forward to Z=176.5 abaft Bulkhead E in accordance with Harland & Wolff's forward entrance foyer general arrangement plans, restoring clear sightlines to the clock.

defects_found.description: Turkish Baths camera position Y=12.0 was set to E-Deck level rather than F-Deck (Y=9.8), viewing overhead pipes rather than the pool basin.
defects_found.resolution: Corrected camera vector to Y=10.8 eye level on F Deck facing the turquoise tiled pool and Moorish ceramic walls.

defects_found.description: Café Parisien lacked forward and aft bulkheads and featured simplified block furniture.
defects_found.resolution: Constructed enclosing forward/aft bulkheads with white deckhouse enamel, added authentic French wooden lattice trellis battens over green walls, and modeled detailed wicker bistro chairs with backs and legs.

defects_found.description: Scotland Road working passage lacked corridor side walls.
defects_found.resolution: Constructed continuous port and starboard white enamel corridor bulkheads with watertight door archways along the 8.5ft passage.

defects_found.description: Reciprocating engine room was underexposed, obscuring the 75-inch stroke connecting rods and valve gear.
defects_found.resolution: Constructed middle catwalk grating platform between engines with polished brass handrails, added brass oiler manifolds, and installed dual-level 4.5 intensity engine room floodlights.

inspection_passes.notes: Generation 4 captures all 32 standardized architectural and engineering inspection viewpoints with full 100% unobstructed WebGL frame buffer rendering (HTML UI elements cleanly hidden during capture). All interior spaces (Café Parisien, Gymnasium, Marconi Station, Wheelhouse, Steerage Saloon, Scotland Road, Turkish Baths, Engine Room) visually verified with authentic 1912 period craftsmanship, materials, and lighting. Approved and published to renders/final/.
